reuse.why: Routes the flag through the existing shared assertBankAccountNotLinked guard used by all six providers and reuses the unlink logic by extracting it from unlinkAccount rather than rewriting it.

duplication.why: The local-unlink field reset is extracted into unlinkAccountLocally and shared by unlinkAccount and the replace path, so no block is duplicated.

placement.why: The change lives in the accounts app where linking and unlinking already live, but the unlink side effect is placed inside a function named assert..., which now mutates data.

scope.why: Only the link parameter type, the shared guard, the provider link functions' pass-through, the extracted unlink helper and one test are touched.

maintainability.why: Single decision point and a reused unlink helper are easy to own, though the misleading assert name with a side effect and the long unwrapped call lines would draw review comments.
